# Eric Dong

> Eric Dong is an app developer and consultant with close to a
> decade in the tech industry, including roughly six years at Google. He now works
> independently building apps and websites for clients and his own products.

## About

- Name: Eric Dong
- Role: App developer and consultant
- Education: B.S. and M.S. in Computer Science, University of Southern California (USC)
- Core skills: React, Angular, TypeScript, Python, LangGraph, Agent2Agent (A2A), AWS, MCP, mobile development, CI/CD

## Experience

- Google — Software Engineer, full time, 2019–2024
  - Cloud Marketplace (2021–2024): full-stack engineer on Google Cloud's marketplace
    platform; one of the earliest engineers on a new team, providing technical
    leadership, project ownership, and mentorship.
  - Google Ads (2019–2021): full-stack engineer on advertiser-facing tools for
    planning and allocating ad spend; delivered an integration with Search Ads 360.
- Hyperloop One — ~3 years
- Yahoo — ~1 year
